known_issues: Undisclosed adapter fields: both adapter suites locate the submission's hooks and timer through `Server.HookPrefix` and `Server.TimerName` and the naming scheme `<HookPrefix>.<HookEvent>` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/prop-ownership-quota-registry/integration/prop-ownership-integration.lua:49-51,84-87,106-108,119-126,146-148; benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/prop-ownership-quota-registry/server/prop-ownership-suite.lua:131-135,211-217). The exam only says the hooks/timer are named (T1-NATIVE-01) and lists neither field. A valid adapter that names its hooks differently or does not export the two fields fails 4 integration cases and aborts Phase B with a nil-concatenation error (all server cases unobserved). Measured by control alternative-strict-reading.

Undisclosed success codes: `registered` and `removed` are compared literally (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/prop-ownership-quota-registry/hidden/prop-ownership-registry.lua:23,51,131; benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/prop-ownership-quota-registry/server/prop-ownership-suite.lua:89,130) but the exam (T1-API-02, T1-ERR-01) defines only failure codes plus `allowed`, `canceled`, `connected`, `shutdown`. Any other success code fails 3 hidden cases and Phase A.

Undisclosed entity marker: Phase B requires `replacement.RheniumBenchmarkEntityRevision == 2` on the real entity (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/prop-ownership-quota-registry/server/prop-ownership-suite.lua:178); the exam never asks BindEntity to write a field on the Entity.

Private result/row shapes: tick data must contain a `removed` list (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/prop-ownership-quota-registry/hidden/prop-ownership-registry.lua:86) and disconnect data a `cleanup_at` field (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/prop-ownership-quota-registry/hidden/prop-ownership-registry.lua:104); the malformed-state variants mutate `latest_revisions[i].revision`, `pending_cleanup[i].cleanup_at` and `requests[i].arguments` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/prop-ownership-quota-registry/hidden/prop-ownership-registry.lua:166-172). The exam names the top-level save lists (T1-PERSIST-03) but no row fields, and does not say unknown row keys must be rejected. An implementation with other row field names that ignores unknown keys accepts e.g. variant 6 and fails the case; variant 5 (`cleanup_at = last_now`) additionally presumes that a pending cleanup due at load time is invalid rather than immediately cleaned.

Fixture trap: the stub adapter environment provides only hook, timer, CurTime, IsValid, isstring, isnumber and include (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/prop-ownership-quota-registry/integration/prop-ownership-integration.lua:39-43). An adapter calling any other GMod global on an exercised path (e.g. istable, SERVER, ents) errors in the integration layer although it works on the real server.
Catalog api_usage cites clause id T1-NATIVE-04 (benchmarks/gmod/catalog.json), which does not exist in the exam; the timer obligation is part of T1-NATIVE-01.

contract-traceability.json contains nominal links that the cited case does not exercise (T1-FILE-01, T1-GOAL-01, T1-GOAL-02, T1-SCOPE-01, T1-SCOPE-02, T1-ERR-02); they are dropped or re-cited in this map and listed in the case notes.

mutations.json is written against references/table-registry while the Harbor oracle installs references/array-registry (lexicographically first); the four core mutations register-not-deduplicated, remove-repeats, quota-not-enforced and malformed-state-shape-accepted do not apply to the oracle text.

Server-layer case granularity: the five-to-eight `server:` cases are the group verdicts of the FINAL phase (B) only (plugins/garrys-mod/src/rhenium_garrys_mod/addons/evaluator.py:255-276 reads `final_payload['cases']`). A failed Phase A assertion stops the run before Phase B (server_runner.py:631-640), so it is never recorded as `F` on its group: every `server:` case becomes unobserved (`U`), `complete` is false and the dedicated-server check scores 0/40. The Phase A group verdicts do exist in the raw execution record (`result.runtime.phase_a.payload.cases`) but are not part of the case table. Phase-A-only evidence therefore acts as a gate, not as a named failing case. For this task Phase A only covers module load, first registration, and the state write (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/prop-ownership-quota-registry/server/prop-ownership-suite.lua:80-111); all authority/quota/lifecycle/cleanup evidence is in Phase B.
